article.title: Weekly market report: Nifty 50 closes at 25,144.30, up 0.46% this week | 13 November 2026
article.dek: The Nifty 50 ended the week at 25,144.30. NSE index scoreboard, sector heatmap, breadth and institutional flows.

visualSpec.weekLabel: Change from the close on Fri 6 Nov to Fri 13 Nov (NSE)
visualSpec.breadthExchange: NSE, Nifty 500 stocks on the day
visualSpec.fiiDiiNote: NSE provisional figures for the cash market, in ₹ crore.

reportTakeaways: The Nifty 50 ended the week 0.46% higher; the Nifty Next 50 gained 1.70%, the Nifty Midcap 100 gained 2.12% and the Nifty Smallcap 100 gained 3.59%.
Sectors up over the week: PSU banks, Media, Realty, Pharma, Healthcare, Private banks, Energy, Consumer durables, Auto, Oil & gas, FMCG.
body: What moved | The Nifty 50 closed the week at 25,144.30, up 0.46% from the previous week's close of 25,030.35 on 6 Nov, and fell 0.61% on the day. Over the week the Nifty Next 50 gained 1.70%, the Nifty Midcap 100 gained 2.12% and the Nifty Smallcap 100 gained 3.59%.
Breadth | On the day 340 stocks in the Nifty 500 fell and 158 rose, according to NSE. India VIX, which measures the volatility traders expect, fell 5.06% to 15.78.
Sectors | Over the week PSU banks did best (+7.50%) and IT worst (−3.17%) among the sector indices in the heatmap.
Flows | NSE's provisional data show foreign portfolio investors were net buyers of ₹5,736.55 crore in the cash market on the day, and domestic institutions were net sellers of ₹2,253.58 crore.
article.indiaImpact: Index, sector and breadth moves together show how widely gains or losses spread beyond the Nifty 50.
